column1: # Every assertion in scripts/check.py, with a mutation that turns it RED and a decoy it must
# NOT fire on. Executed 2026-09-02 against references/flow-routing.md and references/papers.md;
# every mutation applied to the SUBJECT (a document or the bibliography), never to the guard,
# and reverted with a byte-comparison afterwards.
# A guard that has never been seen to fail is not known to be a guard. This file is the
# evidence, and it is the reason the checker may be believed about FORM -- it says nothing
# about whether the cited papers contain what the documents claim.
